dataSource: LADBS Building & Safety permit data (data.lacity.org), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the LA Department of Building and Safety's public Socrata dataset on every search, not a static extract — so coverage reflects whatever LADBS has published as of your search.
LA addresses often include a direction prefix (e.g. "W"); matching falls back to street number + first word of the street name if an exact match isn't found.
summary: Los Angeles is covered by a live query against LADBS's public permit system — building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, matched by address as you search.
